title: Sign-Up and Renewal Loyalty Credit Amounts by Residential Gas Plan
content:
Residential Natural Gas Supply plans carry two one-time bill credit amounts: the sign-up bill credit and the renewal loyalty bill credit. Amounts are in US dollars; 0.00 means the plan carries no such credit.

| Plan | Sign-up credit amount (USD) | Sign-up qualification count: completed billing cycles of continuous supply after which the sign-up credit posts | Unposted sign-up credit forfeited when the agreement leaves active status before qualifying | Renewal loyalty credit amount (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Gas Monthly Variable | 0.00 | 0 | Yes | 0.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Capped Variable 12 | 25.00 | 3 | Yes | 15.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 12 | 40.00 | 3 | Yes | 25.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 24 | 60.00 | 3 | Yes | 40.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 36 | 75.00 | 3 | Yes | 50.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 12 | 40.00 | 3 | Yes | 25.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 24 | 60.00 | 3 | Yes | 40.00 |

The renewal loyalty credit is the one-time bill credit posted when the customer renews into a new term on the plan concerned.

### Reading the table

- Beacon Ridge Gas Monthly Variable carries 0.00 for both credits: it pays neither a sign-up credit nor a renewal loyalty credit.
- The sign-up qualification point is 3 completed billing cycles on every plan that pays a sign-up credit.
- Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 36 carries the largest amounts: 75.00 at sign-up and 50.00 on renewal.
- Plans sharing a figure: Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 12 and Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 12 (40.00 and 25.00); Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 24 and Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 24 (60.00 and 40.00).
